verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://svelte.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a 'Svelte Documentation for LLMs' header. Svelte also publishes llms-small.txt and llms-medium.txt variants, plus per-section llms.txt files for the CLI, Kit and AI docs. A dedicated AI docs section describes an MCP server that feeds agents relevant documentation, so the agent-oriented docs surface is broad and verified. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually being pointed at these files in practice.
